parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 17 - Fate Update

Overview

Pirate King is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained through opening Summer Stars.

Evolving

Pirate King can evolve into Pirate King (Final) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Pirate King
x1 Pirate King's Hat
x12 Star Fruit

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
